search_by_name.description: Search any node by name (Gene.name == symbol).
search_by_name.cypher:
MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.name, n.symbol, '')) CONTAINS toLower($q)
RETURN n
LIMIT 25

expand_neighbors.description: Expand ANY clicked node (works for all labels).
expand_neighbors.cypher:
MATCH (n)-[r]-(m)
WHERE id(n) = $nodeId
RETURN n, r, m
LIMIT $limit
expand_neighbors.cypher_neo4j5:
MATCH (n)-[r]-(m)
WHERE elementId(n) = $elementId
RETURN n, r, m
LIMIT $limit

expand_targets_by_evidence.cypher:
MATCH (n)-[r:TARGETS]-(m)
WHERE id(n) = $nodeId AND r.evidence = $evidence
RETURN n, r, m
LIMIT $limit

expand_from_ingredient_id.description: Seed view from a known ingredient_id (search → expand).
expand_from_ingredient_id.cypher:
MATCH (i:Ingredient {ingredient_id: $ingredientId})-[r]-(m)
RETURN i, r, m
LIMIT $limit

expand_from_gene_symbol.description: Seed view from a gene symbol.
expand_from_gene_symbol.cypher:
MATCH (g:Gene {symbol: $symbol})-[r]-(m)
RETURN g, r, m
LIMIT $limit
